limitations: No cross-system TVL, APR, protocol revenue, or debt ratio is defined by this record.

dimensions.rule: Savings deposits move existing MUSD and do not create a trove or increase classic debt.
sum wallet-held and gauge-custodied beneficial sMUSD once; totalSupply is principal only.
pending protocol yield, indexed but unclaimed user yield, and paid yield are distinct lifecycle values.
MEZO emissions and redirected voter revenue are not Savings principal or classic MUSD interest.

doubleCountingGuards: do not add Savings-held MUSD to MUSD total supply
do not add sMUSD totalSupply to classic MUSD debt
do not count the same receipt in a wallet and in a gauge
do not merge claimable MUSD yield with claimable MEZO rewards
